rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 1 of 4 on two 60 m ropes, trending to the rappeller's right.
rappel_detail.anchor: two-bolt anchor at the southeast base of the summit block
hazards: Check the fixed anchor before weighting it.
rappel_detail.station: The southeast base of the summit block, reached by scrambling down from the summit pedestal.

rappel_detail.pull: Pull carefully: the flake and offwidth features snag ropes readily.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 2 of 4 on two ropes, continuing to the right.
rappel_detail.anchor: fixed anchor at the top of the pitch-5 crux
hazards: Rope snags in the chimney and offwidth sections.
rappel_detail.station: The top of the crux fifth pitch.

rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 3 of 4 on two ropes down slabby terrain.
rappel_detail.station: A fixed station lower on the face, on the slabbier ground to climber's right of the route.

rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 4 of 4, to the snow at the base of the face; collect any gear left there and reverse the snow traverse to Burgundy Col.
rappel_detail.station: The lowest fixed station on the face.

set.rappels: 4 double-rope rappels on two 60 m ropes down the neighbouring Rebel Yell line, from the two-bolt anchor at the southeast base of the summit block; or reverse to the Burgundy-Chianti notch
set.rappel_count_note: Four double-rope rappels on two 60 m ropes from the summit block back to the snow, trending to the rappeller's right. A single 60 m rope may reach some stations but is not the norm. Individual lengths are not published.
